texte.« Après avoir eu CONNAISSANCE de l’incid: “Of becoming AWARE of the significant incident”. Not after it occurs, not after its technical detection. On the day someone in your organisation understood that it was significant, the twenty-four hours started — and nobody announced it.
texte.« Classe » répond à « de quel ordre est: “Class” answers “what order of magnitude is a campus of this type?”, never “how much does this site consume?”. Do not cross this line in a report.
texte.« Comprennent AU MOINS » : ce n’est pas: “Shall include AT LEAST”: it is not a checklist you work through to the end, it is a floor you do not go below. Ticking them all does not prove compliance; missing one undoes it. And two of them — the supply chain and vulnerability disclosure — put you in direct contact with the CRA.
texte.« Des raisons de croire, sur la base des: “Reason to believe, based on the information in its possession”: what you receive and do not read counts as information in your possession. An unopened security bulletin exempts you from nothing.
texte.« Par défaut » signifie que le réglage l: “By default” means that the most protective setting is the one that applies without any action by the user. A privacy option that has to be switched on does not satisfy Article #.
texte.« Pas encore répondu » n'est pas « non »: « Not answered yet » is not « no »: a question with no answer counts neither in the numerator nor in the denominator, and the score says how many it covers.
texte.« Sans objet » sort un paragraphe du cal: « Not applicable » takes a paragraph out of the calculation; a question with no answer counts as zero. The reverse would make the rate rise as one answers LESS.
texte.« Substantielle » s’apprécie au regard d: “Substantial” is assessed with regard to cybersecurity, not technical scale. A minor patch that reopens an attack surface can be substantial; an overhaul that does not touch it may not be.
texte.« Volume source » n’est pas un champ déc: “Source volume” is not a decorative field: an amount for which nobody can say where the volume comes from cannot be defended in committee.

texte.À chiffrer ce que le texte chiffre, en d: To quantify what the text quantifies, saying what the figure IS. Article # requires Member States to provide for fines “of a maximum of at least” €# million or # % of worldwide turnover for essential entities, €# million or # % for important entities. These are FLOORS imposed on the States, not ceilings enforceable against the administration.
texte.À combler — ces systèmes sont en service: To be filled — these systems are in service
texte.À contredire une phrase qui se vend bien: To contradict a phrase that sells well: “our AIMS covers OWASP”. Each risk is linked to the Annex A controls that touch it, by number. Three of them meet none.
texte.À coter le socle « tous risques » que la: To rate the “all-hazards” baseline that the Directive imposes on essential AND important entities: the ten measures are the same for both statuses, only supervision differs. The Article says that the measures “shall include AT LEAST” these ten elements — it is a floor, not a checklist you work through to the end.
texte.À coter les articles du règlement délégu: To rate the articles of Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# that YOUR regime makes enforceable. It has forty-two: Title II carries twenty-six of them for the full framework, Title III fourteen for the simplified framework, and the two sets are disjoint. The first Article is a proportionality principle and Article # is the entry into force — counting them among the requirements would inflate the denominator by two.
texte.À coter les trente sous-articles du corp: To rate the thirty sub-clauses of the body of the standard, and to separate what grafts on from what does not. The structure is the same as that of ISO # — it is the harmonised structure of management systems — so management review, internal audit, nonconformities and documented information carry over. Seven clauses carry over from nowhere.
texte.À coter les trente-deux sous-articles du: To rate the thirty-two sub-clauses of the body of the standard, and above all to give TWO rates instead of one. The first counts everything; the second counts only the nine clauses that # really adds to a management system already in place. An organisation certified to ISO # inherits the harmonised structure — management review, internal audit, nonconformities, documented information — and has only those nine ahead of it. The first rate flatters it; the second tells it where its budget goes.
texte.À coter une par une les vingt et une exi: To rate one by one the twenty-one essential requirements of the Regulation, keeping the two parts of Annex I separate: Part I covers the properties of the product and is verified on a given version; Part II covers the manufacturer’s processes and holds for the whole support period.
texte.À croiser avec le secteur choisi en cart: To be cross-checked with the sector chosen in the mapping.
texte.À dire ce qu’aucun questionnaire d’auto-: To say what no self-assessment questionnaire in circulation says: Annex A went from # controls in # chapters to # in # themes, eleven of them entirely new. The BSI document that served as the starting point for this module dates from # and covers version # — filling it in today prepares you against a withdrawn standard, on a numbering that no longer exists.
texte.À dire qui, de vous ou de votre fourniss: To saying who, between you and your supplier, owes what. This CEN draft standard serves article # of the AI Act and addresses its requirements to the PROVIDER, for the design of the system; what depends on the deployment context is passed to the DEPLOYER through the instructions for use.
texte.À disposer du cadre complet, avec les én: To have the full framework, with the original statements. The seventy-two subcategories are not a questionnaire: they serve as evidence under the nineteen categories, which are the level at which an assessment is really conducted in a workshop.
texte.À donner au comité de direction le seul: To give the executive committee the only CRA figure that is exact and enforceable: the three tiers of fines of Article #, in euros and as a percentage of worldwide turnover. “# million OR # %” is not the authority’s choice — it is whichever is higher, and there is therefore a turnover below which the fixed amount always governs.
texte.À déclarer, paragraphe par paragraphe, o: To declaring, paragraph by paragraph, where the quality management system stands: from the context of the organisation (chapter #) to improvement (chapter #), by way of operation and control (chapter #) and performance evaluation (chapter #), which carries post-market monitoring and the reporting of serious incidents.
texte.À la restitution. Rien ne s’y saisit : l: To the read-out. Nothing is entered here: the score, its caps, the documentation required and the coverage of article # are all DERIVED from what you declared elsewhere.
texte.À la seule partie du cadre qui se CALCUL: To the only part of the framework that is CALCULATED. For each scenario, the standard asks for a reaction time (#); # requires that the intervention latency of the measures chosen be specified, MEASURED and verified as compatible with that deadline. Those are the two numbers the engine compares.
texte.À lire l’annexe ZA dans le sens qui vous: To reading Annex ZA the way round that interests you: not « what does this paragraph cover », but « this subparagraph of article #, who covers it, and where do I stand ». Each row of the Regulation carries the paragraphs of the standard that address it and the rate your answers produce there.
texte.À montrer ce que la France va demander,: To show what France is going to require, which does not take the form of the Directive. In its Article #, the bill replaces the ten measures of Article #(#) with four families — steering, protection, defence, resilience — and refers to ReCyF: twenty security objectives and # acceptable means of compliance. An ANSSI inspection will focus on those.
texte.À montrer ce que la directive demande au: To show what the Directive asks of the board, not of the IT department. It is the first cyber text that names a person: management bodies approve the measures, oversee their implementation, and can be held liable for the entity’s infringement of Article #.
texte.À montrer le seul compte à rebours du rè: To show the only countdown in the Regulation that is already running. Article # has applied since # September #, while the rest of the text waits for December #. A manufacturer who discovers today that one of its vulnerabilities is being actively exploited has twenty-four hours for the early warning.
texte.À montrer une horloge qui ne démarre pas: To show a clock that does not start where you think it does. “Of becoming AWARE of the significant incident” — not when it occurs, not at its technical detection. This moves the question from detection to QUALIFICATION: on the day someone in the company understood that it was significant, the twenty-four hours started, and nobody announced it.
texte.À n’envisager que sous contrat écartant: To be considered only under a contract that explicitly excludes reuse for training, with a known location of processing. If personal data are involved, sending them is a transfer within the meaning of the GDPR, with everything that implies.
texte.À produire ce dont tout le reste de la n: To produce what everything else in the standard follows from. Annex A controls are not chosen from a catalogue: they are DERIVED from risk treatment (clause # b) and c)). Building the Statement of Applicability first, then looking for risks to justify it, gives a document that stands up and protects nothing — and it shows at stage #.
texte.À produire la pièce maîtresse de l’audit: To produce the centrepiece of the stage # audit: the # Annex A controls, each included or excluded, each justified both ways, and — for those included — each with its implementation status. Three columns, where the one for ISO # asks for only two.
texte.À produire le document que l’auditeur ou: To produce the document the auditor opens first, and the only one that can stop certification before anyone has looked at what you do. Each of the thirty-eight Annex A controls is included or excluded in it — and, in both cases, justified. That is what clause # f) requires, word for word: the justification of the inclusion AS WELL AS the exclusion.
